name: candidate-set-head-micro
note: The head in veya/experimental/candidate_set.py is order-equivariant and gradient-checked. A full run freezes the production encoder, trains only CandidateSetHead, and reports recall@k. Do not replace Agent.predict until that run beats the packed head on a held-out schema.

hardware.dev: 1 CPU or Apple MPS, frozen encoder, a few thousand steps
hardware.full: 1 GPU with 16GB, frozen ModernBERT-large, batch of candidate sets
